pool.note: Last-resort goal by category (reached when the stress roll fails and the role has no NPC_FACTION_GOALS entry). Every line is generic: no line presumes a record fact. Not colour (they are goals, not mannerisms), so silent. other#0.short 'this particular difficulty' and military#1.short 'in a crisis' are hedged, not crisis claims.

rows.text: Survive the current political season without a major scandal
Build lasting institutional reform that outlives their tenure
Consolidate their position before rivals can organise
Die having made this place meaningfully better
Train the next cohort to a standard that might actually keep people alive
Build a force that doesn't need them: sustainable, not dependent
Identify the weak link before the weak link identifies itself in a crisis
Achieve enough distinction to be remembered without being mourned too soon
Settle a theological dispute that has divided the congregation for months
Strengthen the faith: not the institution, the actual living faith
Obtain the resources needed for a desperately needed charitable project
Be worthy of the role they hold, which turns out to be the harder task
Close the deal that will determine this year's profitability
Build something that doesn't need them to keep running
Identify the leak in their supply chain before it empties the accounts
Leverage money into influence: that's where security actually lives
Eliminate the threat before it becomes a bigger threat
Build insulation between themselves and consequences
Find who betrayed them before they do it again
Put enough by that going straight is a choice they can make
Solve the magical problem that has been festering for three weeks
Advance understanding of something that was genuinely unknown
Find someone capable enough to not endanger others
Leave magic in a better state than they found it
Get through this particular difficulty without it becoming a catastrophe
Build enough stability that they have choices
Figure out what is actually going on before it affects them directly
Matter to the people immediately around them: small scale, real
